name: com.szymonpaluch/mcp
title: Claude certification practice exams and AI blog
description: Free, unofficial practice questions for five Claude certifications, plus an AI blog (EN/PL).

tools.name: practice_question
tools.description: One question from Szymon Paluch's free, unofficial practice exams for the Claude certifications: ccar-f = Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (60 questions); ccar-p = Claude Certified Architect – Professional (70 questions); ccao-f = Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (70 questions); ccdv-f = Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (70 questions); ccdv-p = Claude Certified Developer – Professional (70 questions). Choose the exam with `exam` (default ccar-f, Architect – Foundations, which Szymon passed with 833/1000). Returns the scenario, question, options, the correct answer and an explanation; some questions are multiple response and say how many answers to select. Show the question and options first and reveal the answer only after the user has answered. Filter by exam domain (the first result names it; an out-of-range domain lists them all) or ask for a question number. Questions are in English, as on the real exams.

exam.description: Which exam: ccar-f = Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (60 questions); ccar-p = Claude Certified Architect – Professional (70 questions); ccao-f = Claude Certified Associate – Foundations (70 questions); ccdv-f = Claude Certified Developer – Foundations (70 questions); ccdv-p = Claude Certified Developer – Professional (70 questions).

domain.description: Only questions from this exam domain (1–5 for ccar-f, 1–6 for ccao-f, 1–7 for ccar-p, 1–8 for ccdv-f and ccdv-p).

number.description: A specific question number in that exam. Overrides domain.

exclude.description: Question numbers already asked in this session; they will not be picked again.

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search Szymon Paluch's blog (agentic engineering, AI implementation, Claude certification, AI in companies). Returns matching posts with title, date, summary, slug and URL. Every post exists in English and Polish under the same slug.

query.description: Words to look for in titles, summaries and post text.

tools.name: read_post
tools.description: Full text of one blog post as Markdown, with its URL, date and FAQ. Takes the slug from search_posts, or the post URL.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: Szymon Paluch's services (AI implementation, consulting, workshops, speaking, the Certified AI Consultant Program) with indicative prices in PLN (net, primary) and USD (converted). Final quotes are scoped per engagement.

tools.name: get_speaking
tools.description: Szymon Paluch's conference talks, meetups, podcasts and trainings since 2014, newest first. Only engagements verified against a public source.

tools.name: book_a_call
tools.description: The link to book a call with Szymon Paluch, plus his email and phone.
